---
title: "Patch main figure — normal2mci scatter & ES correlation"
---

## Overview

Apply publication theming to the normal-to-MCI scatter plots and effect-size correlation panels, compose into a single multi-panel main figure, and save as high-resolution PNG.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load RDS plots

```{r}
#| label: load-rds

sct_DMP_main <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/scatter_DMP_main.rds"))
sct_extended_DMP_main <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/scatter_extended_DMP_main.rds"))
line_plot_ES_corr_main <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/line_plot_ES_corr_main.rds"))
```

## Apply theme and rescale

```{r}
#| label: theme-rescale

sct_DMP_main$prev <- sct_DMP_main$prev + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
  )

sct_DMP_main$mci2incid <- sct_DMP_main$mci2incid + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
  )

sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2incid_vs_prev <- sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2incid_vs_prev +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
  )

sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2mci_vs_prev <- sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2mci_vs_prev +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
  )

line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev <- line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = NA),
  )

line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid <- line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = NA),
  )

# Rescale geom sizes for publication column width
sct_DMP_main$prev <- rescale_layer_params(sct_DMP_main$prev, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
sct_DMP_main$mci2incid <- rescale_layer_params(sct_DMP_main$mci2incid, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2incid_vs_prev <- rescale_layer_params(sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2incid_vs_prev, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2mci_vs_prev <- rescale_layer_params(sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2mci_vs_prev, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev <- rescale_layer_params(line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid <- rescale_layer_params(line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
```

## Compose and save

```{r}
#| label: compose-main-fig
fs::dir_create(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output"))

fig_normal2mci <-
(sct_DMP_main$prev + sct_DMP_main$mci2incid) -
  (sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2incid_vs_prev + sct_extended_DMP_main$normal2mci_vs_prev) +
  (line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev + line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(2, 2, 3), guides = "collect", axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_normal2mci.png"),
       fig_normal2mci,
       width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*fig_normal2mci*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
